description: This file defines a ThemeProvider component and related context for managing light/dark theme switching in a React Native app. It includes theme persistence using AsyncStorage and provides hooks for theme consumption.

methods.name: ThemeProvider
methods.description: A React functional component that provides theme context and manages theme state with persistence.

methods.name: useTheme
methods.description: Custom hook to access theme context values, ensuring it's used within ThemeProvider.
